text:
Sam: Quick sync on vector preview keyboard nav + export options after testing with screen reader. Found a few small but important UX issues.
Nia: thanks — can you summarize the blockers?
Sam: 1) row focus lands after the inline actions, so keyboard users have to tab twice to hit the kebab; 2) export modal doesn't expose the chosen format (CSV vs JSONL) to screen reader; 3) sample mode label 'Top' vs 'Best' is ambiguous.
Carlos: for (1) we can flip the tab order: action menu should be last in source order but first in keyboard order with an explicit tabindex=0.
Tara: be careful: changing source order affects DOM reading for assistive tech. Better to keep DOM order and use skip links or a visible "Actions" button with aria-controls to jump.
Owen: backend note: export already supports `format=csv|jsonl|ndjson` and `include_source=false` defaults. We can add `sample.mode=top|random|percentile`. No perf impact.
Sam: nice. For (2) propose: export modal starts with a live region summarizing selections: "Export 120 vectors • format: CSV • include source: no". Screen readers will announce.
Nia: agree. Add a small change log line explaining what CSV does vs JSONL (e.g., embedding column as JSON array vs base64).
Carlos: UI quirk: current CSV preview shows truncated arrays like `[0.12, 0.0...` which is misleading. We should render a shortened badge like `embedding (dim=768)` and on hover show full sample.
Tara: a11y: ensure hover content is also keyboard-accessible (focusable and dismissible with Esc). Also tooltips should use role="tooltip" and be connected via aria-describedby.
Sam: copy nit: sample dropdown currently says "Sample: Top 50" can we change to "Preview sample: 50 (top)" to be clearer.
Nia: product: any privacy concerns if we make preview show full source text inline? We should mask by default and provide a reveal button per-row with confirmation.
Owen: agree. Implement `reveal_source` action that records audit events. API-wise it's fine.
QA-Bot: Automated test suggestion: keyboard-only flow to open export modal, change format, toggle include_source, and verify aria-live summary updates.
Carlos: export filename generation: when including source we currently append `_with_source`, but that leaks presence in filenames. Maybe avoid making it obvious and instead include metadata file inside the zip documenting choices.
Tara: accessibility: the table sorting control must announce the active sort. Use aria-live polite to say "sorted by score descending" when changed.
Sam: small layout ask: in compact rows, reduce avatar to 24px and increase left padding by 4px to improve visual rhythm.
Nia: I'll update the spec doc and the copy strings. Tara, can you draft the a11y checklist for this flow?
Tara: yes, will post checklist with keyboard steps and expected announcements.
Owen: I'll add the sample params and export metadata file in the API. Carlos, can you handle tooltip behavior?
Carlos: on it. Will push a small CSS/JS patch to make hover tooltips tabbable.
Sam: let's also include a one-click "Download sample" that zips only the preview sample; respects include_source toggle.
Nia: good idea for validation before full export.
QA-Bot: Added test case to board: EXPORT-KEYNAV-01, EXPORT-SAMPLE-02.
Sam: thanks everyone, I'll run a 5-min usability test with two folks tomorrow and report back. :rocket:
